scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && mkdir -p ../release && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../release/jogoo-debug.apk && echo "APK: release/jogoo-debug.apk"
scripts.build:staff: tsc -b && vite build -c vite.staff.config.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['sw.js','manifest.webmanifest','flutter_service_worker.js','_headers','pwa-192.png','pwa-512.png','pwa-maskable-512.png','apple-touch-icon.png'])fs.rmSync('dist-staff/'+f,{force:true})"
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease && cd .. && mkdir -p release && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk release/jogoo-release.apk && cp android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab release/jogoo-release.aab
